FX-LIQUIFY-001.says: The settings as they start: Warp, brush 64, pressure 50, and no stroke: the drawing, untouched.

FX-LIQUIFY-002.says: Warp, brush 8, pressure 50, stroked across the middle from a quarter to three quarters: the stripes under the stroke pushed right.

FX-LIQUIFY-003.says: Twirl Clockwise, brush 10, pressure 100, one dab in the middle: the stripes there turned clockwise.

FX-LIQUIFY-004.says: Twirl Counterclockwise, as FX-LIQUIFY-003: turned the other way.

FX-LIQUIFY-005.says: Pucker, brush 10, pressure 100, one dab in the middle: the drawing drawn in toward it.

FX-LIQUIFY-006.says: Bloat, as FX-LIQUIFY-005: swollen out from it.

FX-LIQUIFY-007.says: Shift Pixels, stroked as FX-LIQUIFY-002: the stripes moved square to the stroke, up the picture, to its left.

FX-LIQUIFY-008.says: FX-LIQUIFY-002 at Distortion Percentage 200: pushed twice as far.

FX-LIQUIFY-009.says: FX-LIQUIFY-002 with the Distortion Mesh Offset 3 pixels right: the push lands three pixels on.

FX-LIQUIFY-010.says: FX-LIQUIFY-002 with the layer moved three pixels right: the pushed drawing moves with it.

FX-LIQUIFY-011.says: Distortion Percentage keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4, linear: frame 0 the drawing, frame 4 FX-LIQUIFY-002, frame 2 between.

FX-LIQUIFY-012.says: The stroke keyed from across the middle at frame 0 to rising to the top right at frame 4: the push turns upward.

FX-LIQUIFY-013.says: Warp, brush 6, pressure 80, stroked down and back up in a V: the push follows each leg.

FX-LIQUIFY-014.says: Brush Pressure keyed from 20 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4, eased past its end: frame 2 would pass 100 and is held there, the same as frame 4.

FX-LIQUIFY-015.says: Warp with a brush of 1000, wider than the drawing: the whole drawing pushed right almost evenly, four pixels, clear down the left.

FX-LIQUIFY-016.says: Tool "freeze", not one of the six. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-LIQUIFY-017.says: Brush Size 0, below 1. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-LIQUIFY-018.says: Brush Pressure 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-LIQUIFY-019.says: A stroke of three numbers, half a point over. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-LIQUIFY-020.says: Distortion Percentage 201, above 200. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-LIQUIFY-021.says: The stroke keyed to end at 300 per cent across at frame 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
